scenario.title: Bike share introduction
scenario.place: Bike share station, outside the student center
scenario.intro: You are joining the campus bike share program. A staff member is explaining how it works to a small group of students. Listen and repeat what the staff member says.

sentences: Hold your card near the screen.
The light turns green when the bike is unlocked.
Remember to adjust the seat before you start riding.
Your first thirty minutes are free, and after that you pay one dollar.
If a bike has a flat tire, press the red button so that our team can repair it.
When you return a bike, push it firmly into an empty dock and wait until you hear a short beep, or the ride will not end.
